description: This file defines the SplashActivity class, which displays a splash screen for 3 seconds and then navigates to HomeActivity. It manages UI focus and handles lifecycle events to ensure proper navigation and cleanup.

classes.name: SplashActivity
classes.description: A splash screen activity that displays the app brand for 3 seconds before navigating to the HomeActivity.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, manages focus, and schedules navigation to HomeActivity after a delay.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up handler callbacks to prevent memory leaks when the activity is destroyed.
